role: CI guard (make sendable-guard; ci.yml, gates.yml) that `@unchecked Sendable` / `nonisolated(unsafe)` appear only in 14 allowlisted files and their non-comment count does not exceed .ci/unchecked_sendable_budget.txt.
toplevel: cd to repo root; sources preflight; gate_mktemp (exit on failure). find|xargs grep -nHE writes path:line:content hits (errors swallowed with `|| true`). awk drops hits whose content (after leading whitespace) starts with `//` or `*`. Any hit file not in ALLOWLIST -> prints it with its matches and exit 1. Then count of real hits vs budget file: exit 2 if missing or not a whole number; count > budget -> exit 1; else OK. 14 real hits, one per allowlisted file, budget 14. The comment above the budget check says each escape's justification sits in its file and names the two kept on purpose (WorkoutStartCue, WatchConnectivityBridge+Session).
